div.p: The undersigned Katherine Legua, as the legal representative of the certification body Primus Auditing Ops and , as the Legal Representative of , agree to sign this contract that will be governed by the following clauses:

ol.li: The petitioner has voluntarily requested the certification to Primus Chile S.p.A.
Following the GLOBALG.A.P Scheme Integrated farm Assurance - Fruits and vegetables.
Requesting a certification does not guarantee obtaining a positive decision from Primus Chile S.p.A.
The petitioner declares that he/she has read, understood and applied the certification standards in the legal entity.
Primus Chile S.p.A. accepts evaluating all requests under this certification program to the extent of all its administrative capacities, without distinction of race, nationality, size of the unit.

If Primus Chile S.p.A. has evidence to believe that a petitioner has voluntarily violated the certification standards or made false statements, then Primus Chile S.p.A. can deny or withdraw the certification without previously issuing a notification of non-compliance.

div.p:
I. Obligations of the Contracting Party (CP).
Comply with the procedures established by Primus Chile S.p.A. for the audit registration process.
Maintain compliance with the requirements of the certification scheme at all times during the entire period of validity of the certificate.
Allow free access of inspectors/auditors during the normal working day to their production centers, offices, employees and all books and records related to the audited scheme, which are necessary to prove compliance or application of the audited scheme either in audits that have been scheduled as well as for unannounced audits.
If a contractor intervenes in the production, Primus Chile S.p.A is authorized to carry out a complete physical audit of a contractor's facilities. The CP must ensure that the subcontractor allows, on request, the free access stipulated in the previous clause.
Keep a records system that demonstrates compliance with the applicable certification scheme and keep those records according to the requirements of the corresponding standard.
Without delay, notify the certification body of the changes that may affect its ability to comply with the requirements of the certification: Example changes in the legal status, organization or ownership, contact addresses or production sites, modification of products.
Do not hide information that could affect the outcome of the certification process.
Provide the Certification Body with access to information on the handling of complaints from clients or the owner of the certification scheme, related to compliance with the audited scheme.
Keep records of complaints regarding compliance with certification requirements and making such records available to the certification body when requested. Records of actions taken to resolve complaints must also be kept.
The participation of observers during the audit process must be requested to the CP by the CB and the participation of observers is only allowed if they have been authorized by the audited entity.

II. Obligations of Primus Chile S.p.A.
Provide the petitioner all the necessary information and documentation to carry out the registration process, prior to the start of the formal certification process.
Inform the petitioner about changes in the applicable rules and procedures.
Maintain an open and effective communication with the CP.
Maintain confidentiality regarding the information provided by the CP. Only the owners of the scheme and/or Primus Chile S.p.A accreditation body will have access to this information.
Provide a professional, impartial and non-discriminatory service.
Refuse to provide service when there is a conflict of interest.
Notify the owner of the scheme in case of non-compliance, penalties and suspensions of the contracting party.
Request authorization from the contracting party for the participation of observers during the audit process. The participation of observers will be only allowed if they have been authorized by the audited entity. The observers of the Accreditation Body constitute a single exception, in which case the Contracting Party will be informed, but cannot refuse to have an observer of the accreditation body participating in the audit carried out by the Certification body.

III. Regarding this certification contract.
This contract is valid for one year from the signature thereof and will be automatically renewed unless a voluntary withdrawal by the contracting party is presented. In this case the petitioner will communicate it in writing at least 3 months in advance.
Primus Chile SpA reserves the right to deny or withdraw the certification if the petitioner does not comply with the applicable regulations or if they cannot prove that they are complying with them, if they do not comply with those established in the sublicense contracts when requested by the owner of the scheme. Also, in case the petitioner does not comply with the obligations established in this contract including timely payment for the service provided.

IV. Other Issues.
Use of logos, stamps and certificates.
The Contracting Party must make correct use of the certificate, logos and identification numbers generated as a result of the certification process.
The Contracting Party must provide truthful and consistent information on the scope of its certification..
The Contracting Party provides copies of the certification documents and these must be complete.
The Contracting Party must make use of the logos and trademarks of the owner of the scheme in accordance with the provisions of the sub-license agreement.
During the period of suspension or once the certification is completed, the Contracting Party cannot make use of the logo / trademark of GLOBALG.A.P, of the license / Certificate or any other document that has any relation with the Audited Scheme in relation to the suspended product.
The inappropriate use of references to the certification scheme, or the misleading use of licenses, certificates, compliance marks or any other mechanism to indicate that a product is certified, found in the documentation or in other publicity, may be sanctioned by the certification body.

V. Payment.
The requesting party agrees to pay the fee established in the quote previously sent and reviewed by the petitioner. Such quote will not include the estimated expenses for tickets, transportation, lodging and food for the inspectors/auditors.
If the certification was not granted or the petitioner decides to withdraw from it, they must pay all the expenses quoted, and travel and administrative expenses that have already been made.

VI. Appeals and Disputes.
Appeals, claims and disputes filed by the applicant or other parties must be made and are subject to the appeals procedure of Primus Chile S.p.A.

For legal persons, you must attach evidence that the person who signs as a legal representative has legal power of signature granted by the organization you represent. Example Incorporation of a company in Chile; Social contract in Brazil or other document that in your country verifies the name of the legal representative.
